scenarios.title: A card with mayhem can be cast from the graveyard for its mayhem cost only if it was discarded this turn
decisions: A activates Wild Mongrel, discarding Electro's Bolt as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
A casts Electro's Bolt from A's graveyard for its mayhem cost {1}{R}, tapping two Mountains, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; Electro's Bolt resolves.

variants.label: discarded_this_turn
variants.expected: Casting Electro's Bolt from the graveyard for {1}{R} is legal. It deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears, which moves to B's graveyard, and Electro's Bolt then goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: in_graveyard_from_earlier
variants.delta: Electro's Bolt has been in A's graveyard since an earlier turn, so it was not discarded this turn; A's hand is empty and A does not activate Wild Mongrel.
variants.expected: Casting Electro's Bolt from the graveyard is not legal. Grizzly Bears takes no damage.

variants.label: one_mountain
variants.expected: Casting Electro's Bolt from the graveyard is not legal: the mayhem cost {1}{R} cannot be paid. Grizzly Bears takes no damage.

scenarios.forge_notes: Wild Mongrel is only a way to discard a card at a chosen time.

scenarios.title: A card with mayhem and no cost can be played from the graveyard only if it was discarded this turn
decisions: A activates Wild Mongrel, discarding Oscorp Industries as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
A plays Oscorp Industries from A's graveyard as A's land play for the turn.

variants.label: discarded_this_turn
variants.expected: Playing Oscorp Industries from the graveyard is legal. It enters the battlefield tapped, and A loses 2 life (18) because it entered from a graveyard.

variants.label: in_graveyard_from_earlier
variants.delta: Oscorp Industries has been in A's graveyard since an earlier turn, so it was not discarded this turn; A's hand is empty and A does not activate Wild Mongrel.
variants.expected: Playing Oscorp Industries from the graveyard is not legal. A's life stays 20.

variants.label: land_play_already_used
variants.delta: A has already played a land earlier this turn.
variants.expected: Playing Oscorp Industries from the graveyard is not legal: A has no land play left. Oscorp Industries stays in A's graveyard and A's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Oscorp Industries carries K:Mayhem with no cost.
